data.comment:
# Comfy Runway- Gen4 Turbo Image to Video

Generate dynamic videos from images using Runway Gen4 Turbo. Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs Comfy Cloud partner credits.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/api_runway_gen4_turbo_image_to_video.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.

data.prompt: A man sits alone in a dimly lit room, smoking a cigarette. The smoke slowly fills the space. He suddenly turns his head to look directly at the camera, making clear eye contact. The camera then slowly pushes forward toward his face, ending in a close-up. The mood is cinematic and introspective. Shallow depth of field, dramatic lighting, soft shadows, 24fps film look.
